gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing. p5 Other Governmental Funds column prints Issuance of Long-Term Debt 3,200,000 (JSON debt_proceeds), Payment to Refunded Bond Escrow Agent (3,200,000) and Proceeds from Sale of Capital Assets 80,000 (JSON other_financing -3,120,000). All three are already in detail[]: Miscellaneous Projects Fund 'Issuance of Debt' 3,200,000 and 'Payment to Refunded Bond Escrow Agent' -3,200,000 (p23 Capital Project Funds budget schedule), Fire Fund 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' 80,000 (p15). The schedule total 80,000 nets all three non-transfer other-financing lines (3,200,000 - 3,200,000 + 80,000) while the statement side counts only the 3,200,000 proceeds; the escrow payment -3,200,000 and the sale 80,000 sit in the statement's other_financing. Detail non-transfer other financing 80,000 = statement debt_proceeds 3,200,000 + other_financing -3,120,000 = 80,000. No fix.
